RAM, Disk, and Redis backend create/read/write/readdir/stat/find/glob/du/file-operation tests
Redis-backed index and file cache tests
workspace cache invalidation and cache mount tests
workspace snapshot and snapshot drift tests
cross-mount command behavior across RAM, Redis, S3/moto, OneDrive fake Graph, LanceDB, and virtual-root mounts
Python examples for RAM/Disk/Redis VFS, Redis index/cache/VFS, custom commands, and version branching
boundaries: This is not a full Mirage CI reproduction: TypeScript parity, FUSE mount integration, MongoDB/Postgres/Chroma/Qdrant service tests, Camel tests, and live SaaS/API backends were not run in this pass.
The reproduced workloads are source-backed agent VFS behavior and command-oracle seeds for namei_ext workload design; they do not prove Mirage performance or full provider coverage.
No claim is made that these workloads require namei_ext or eBPF policy logic.
verdict: Mirage provides a strong reproducible agent-VFS workload seed for multi-backend namespaces, command conformance, cache behavior, snapshots, cross-mount operations, and version branching. Use it as a source workload/oracle and possible FUSE/VFS-family baseline seed, not as a proof of interface necessity.
